scaleRationale.description: Explain scale in relation to budget, brief and site; justify an unusually compact luxury residence.

basis.description: Exact requirements, assumptions, property value versus construction budget, site constraints and why this accommodation fits.

allowanceM2.description: Additional circulation, walls, storage or service allowance for this whole allocation; do not count it twice.

accessIds.description: Existing entrance IDs at actual passages, or supported stair/landing route IDs. A recessed entrance may reach a floor across a proven clear, level rectangular slab route; proximity alone does not prove it. Fixed glazing is not a door; never cite glazing IDs as access.

content.text:
{"prompt":"Design and construct an extraordinary contemporary Caribbean waterfront estate in Saint Lucia with an estimated property value of US$25 million.

The property occupies a spacious waterfront site with ocean views and a gently sloping landscape.

Create a sophisticated luxury residence with approximately six generous bedroom suites, expansive living and entertainment spaces, a memorable entrance, exceptional indoor-outdoor connections, substantial terraces, a spectacular infinity pool and integrated tropical landscaping.

Develop a coherent architectural concept with impressive massing, coordinated building volumes, beautiful proportions, interesting elevations, sophisticated materials and an unmistakable luxury-estate presence.

You have creative freedom over the building composition, number of levels, architectural style, roof forms and overall arrangement.

Construct the complete, editable 3D exterior architecture rather than a small conceptual representation.","mode":"generate"}

issues: Programme construction commitments are unrecorded; narrative spaces do not establish built accommodation.
